tasks.title: A link shortener
tasks.statement: A shortener: 4000 redirects and 40 link creations per second, 500 GB of data, a working set of about 5 GB. The S database cannot take these reads. Add a cache (≥90% hits) with a replica so the design survives a cache failure, and stay within $1400 per month. Load at most 80%.
tasks.hint: A 5 GB cache with TTL 3600 gives about 93%; with a replica it survives a failure. Eight M app servers; an S database is enough (almost all reads come from the cache).

tasks.title: A view counter
tasks.statement: View counters: 3000 updates per second plus 500 reads. Every update writes to the database, and it is overloaded: an M database handles 600 writes. Losing a few seconds of counts is acceptable. Enable deferred cache writes (write-back) and choose the database: load at most 80%, budget $1800 per month. The “NoSQL” type will help too.
tasks.hint: Write-back leaves 40% of writes in the database: 1200 per second. A NoSQL M handles 1080 writes: two shards give 56%. The application needs seven M servers.

tasks.title: A shared rate limiter
tasks.statement: A rate limiter spread across several servers must keep a shared counter in fast storage. Build the design: a rate limiter at the entrance (limit of at least 3000, otherwise we would cut ordinary traffic of 2700 requests), a cache for the shared counters with a replica (survives a failure), and app servers at most 80%.
tasks.hint: lb → limiter → servers; the cache is connected to the servers, and the cache has a replica. Limit 3000–3500.

tasks.title: Storing snippets
tasks.statement: A snippet storage service: 4000 requests per second to serve ready-made files, plus 800 reads and 50 writes of metadata. Right now the app servers serve the files. Move them out: a CDN in front of object storage (≥90%), with the servers and database handling metadata. Load at most 80%, budget $650 per month.
tasks.hint: CDN → storage (static content bypasses the servers), dynamic requests go through the load balancer. Two M servers are enough, and an M database (800 metadata reads per second do not fit on an S).

tasks.title: A shortener with statistics
tasks.statement: The chapter's final exercise. A shortener with a click counter: 3000 redirects and 3000 recorded click writes per second. Build the design: a cache with write-back and a replica (hits ≥70%: with half of operations being writes, the cache serves less), a NoSQL database with shards and a replica with automatic failover, load at most 80%, survives failure of the database, the cache and an app server, and a budget of $3200 per month.
tasks.hint: Twelve M servers (6000 requests); a 4 GB cache with a replica and write-back; a NoSQL M: two shards with a replica and automatic failover.
